mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCdPrimaryActivityDetailRegPopList*/ SELECT BUYER ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,VISIT_DATE ,VISIT_TIME ,STATUS ,VISIT_TYPE ,VISIT_NOTE ,IMAGE_KEY ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_USER_DEPT ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(VISIT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS T_VISIT_DATE ,TO_VISIT_TIME ,KEP_CFRC_NM ,BUYER_CFRC_RM ,CFRC_PALCE FROM KEP_VISITDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{com_code} AND A.ADD_DATE = #{add_date} AND A.ADD_TIME = #{add_time} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'
